import mujoco, json
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('mjcf.xml')
joints=[]
for j in range(m.njnt):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,j)
    jt=int(m.jnt_type[j])
    tmap={0:'free',1:'ball',2:'slide',3:'hinge'}
    ax=m.jnt_axis[j].tolist()
    lim=m.jnt_range[j].tolist() if m.jnt_limited[j] else None
    joints.append(dict(name=name,type=tmap[jt],axis=ax,range=lim))
print(json.dumps(joints,indent=0))
print('---ACT---')
for a in range(m.nu):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR,a)
    trn=int(m.actuator_trntype[a]); tid=int(m.actuator_trnid[a,0])
    if trn==0: jn=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,tid)
    elif trn==3: jn='tendon:'+str(mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_TENDON,tid))
    else: jn=None
    cr=m.actuator_ctrlrange[a].tolist()
    print(name,jn,cr)
print('---SITES---')
for s in range(m.nsite):
    print(mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,s))
print('nq',m.nq,'nu',m.nu,'neq',m.neq)
"
